runtimeCost.note: — (a member has no posture membership or only a declared tier)

tiers.runtimeBasis: a posture step's CPU share is a property of a group of services; the sensor's tier is the tier of the step that first emits it (coordinator default), not a per-sensor measurement
tiers.runtimeCaveat: decision 101: the tier is the CUMULATIVE share of the posture steps needed to emit the sensor (an async sensor also pays the selected step); a set's runtime cost is the latest first-emission step among its members, so a cap is a set-level deployment cost; each frontier point reports it (runtimeCost)
